body.name: Fixed-query observed-law functional
body.construction:
For a labelled kernel
\(\xi=(\mathbb K_\xi;\mu,m,\Sigma)\in
\mathcal M_{N,T,\mathbf n}(z_0)\), define the observed-law functional
\[
 \theta_{\mathrm{ker}}(\xi;z_0)
 =\sum_{s=1}^{S}\pi_s\{\mu_s-m_s(z_{0s})\}.
\]
This definition does not identify the causal target.  For a kernel induced
by a causal panel law, equality with \(\tau(z_0)\) is a consequence of
\texttt{lem:causal-identification}.
